params.body:
Follow-up to #326, and a gap I left in it. The profile was computed and never reached the surface agents read: `FleetBrief` exports `rung` and dropped `pac`, so a brief said `propose` without the reason. An agent that cannot see why will ask again tomorrow for what was refused today.

`autonomy` now travels on every task: `level` and `name` in PAC's words (A1 to A5), `blast` plus `blastMeaning`, `verifiedBy`, `infrastructure` read from the evidence, `reliability` with its margin, the `bar` the blast radius asks for, `reversal`, `heldBy`, and `why` in one sentence. Null for work no hand declares.

`rung` keeps its three words, so nothing downstream changes: brief version 5 is additive.

Documented in `docs/fleet-brief.md` with the field table and a version note, and the brief's own test now reads `FleetBrief::VERSION` instead of a literal, so the next bump does not need a test edit to notice it.
params.title: De brief draagt de reden, niet alleen de trede (versie 5)
